thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 08/23/2018: SMCI, CMTL, ATVI, BABA

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 08/23/2018: SMCI, CMTL, ATVI, BABA
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks:
MSFT. +0.3%
AAPL. +0.2%
IBM. -0.2%
CSCO. -0.1%
GOOG. -0.1%
Technology stocks were mixed at session's half Thursday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.2% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was climbing almost 0.3%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Super Micro Computer ( SMCI ) rose more than 7% after it said that it plans to appeal a decision by Nasdaq to delist its shares. Nasdaq issued a notice suspending SMCI shares from trading from market open Thursday as the company previously announced that it did not expect to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements by the Friday deadline. During the appeal period, trading in the SMCI stock on Nasdaq will remain suspended and Nasdaq will not delist the shares, the company said.
In other sector news:
+ Comtech Telecommunications ( CMTL ) rose marginally after it said one of its units in Arizona won a $1.3 million order for satellite communications infrastructure equipment from a major defense contractor in Q4.
- Activision Blizzard ( ATVI ) fell some 0.8% even as it said that it sold more than 3.4 million units of the latest World of Warcraft expansion worldwide on Aug. 14, enough to set a new day-one sales record for the franchise and making it one of the fastest-selling PC games of all time.
- Alibaba Group Holding ( BABA ) fell more than 1% after it said fiscal Q1 GAAP EPS were RMB3.30 ($0.50) and non-GAAP diluted EPS was RMB8.04 ($1.22). The CapIQ mean was for GAAP EPS of $0.28 and normalized EPS of $1.24. Sales for the quarter ended June 30 rose 61% year-over-year to RMB80.92 billion ($12.23 billion), topping estimates for $12.02 billion.
